claims.text: Black Arrow OS is a free browser-based pocket CRM with drag-and-drop pipeline and follow-up scheduling
It includes a weekly KPI dashboard showing CPL and ROAS
No signup required, free edition capped at 25 contacts

disclosure: Source: 2026 Google Business Profile messaging coverage (PinMeTo, Moore Tech Solutions)

claims.text: Google is phasing out native Business Profile Chat in favor of WhatsApp and SMS integrations
Most service businesses take hours, not minutes, to respond to a new lead
Adding more messaging channels without a unified system raises the risk of a missed or delayed reply
The Black Arrow platform can route calls, texts, and GBP-originated messages into one inbox with automated text-back
